input_file.description: Path to input file. Defaults to /dev/stdin if not specified.

output_file.description: Path to output file. Defaults to /dev/stdout if not specified.

prompt_mode.description: Enable -p: Prompt user for console input.

single_string_mode.description: Enable -s: Treat input as a single string instead of parsing S-expressions.

output_advanced.description: Enable -a: Write output in advanced transport format.

output_base64.description: Enable -b: Write output in base-64 format.

output_canonical.description: Enable -c: Write output in canonical format.

line_width.description: Set line width (-w). 0 implies no constraint.

loop_mode.description: Enable -x: Execute main loop repeatedly until end of file.
